company.name: Mono
company.shortDescription: Mono is a fintech company that offers a platform for banking organizations to launch financial products and services.
company.description: Mono is on its way to become the 'bankingless bank' of Latin American SMBs, starting with Colombia.

productsAndServices.description: A white-label digital wallet infrastructure that lets companies assign virtual balances, manage funds, and provide branded payment and transfer capabilities to their users.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Wallets (Billeteras digitales)

productsAndServices.description: A business collections service that accepts payments through PSE and Bre-B, assigns references to transactions, and provides real-time notifications and reconciliation through links, dashboards, webhooks, or APIs.
productsAndServices.name: Payins (Recaudo empresarial)

productsAndServices.description: A payment-disbursement service for sending funds to employees, suppliers, customers, affiliates, or other recipients through ACH and Bre-B from a centralized dashboard or API.
productsAndServices.name: Payouts (Dispersión de pagos)

productsAndServices.description: A white-label card issuing service for creating physical, virtual, and tokenized Visa cards with configurable spending limits, merchant restrictions, funding rules, and real-time controls.
productsAndServices.name: Visa Business Cards (Tarjetas Visa empresariales)

productsAndServices.description: A Bre-B collections service that lets companies receive immediate, identified payments through static keys, dynamic keys, or QR codes, with transaction notifications and reconciliation.
productsAndServices.name: Receive Payments with Bre-B (Recibe pagos con Bre-B)

productsAndServices.description: A business payment service for sending instant transfers to recipients at participating Colombian banks using Bre-B keys, individually or in bulk, with pre-validation and transaction status reporting.
productsAndServices.name: Pay with Bre-B (Pagar con Bre-B)
